name: Concert Laser Rig
promptTemplate: A high-octane concert laser rig slicing through thick stage haze in {{palette}} hues, running in {{laser_mode}} mode with {{beam_count}} beams at {{scan_speed}}x speed, {{haze_density}} haze volume, crowd silhouettes {{crowd_silhouettes}}, and beat strobing {{strobe_on_beat}}.

laser_mode.hint: Switch between liquid sheets, cones, or sweeping fans

beam_count.hint: Increase density of scanned light lines

haze_density.hint: Fill room with thicker smoke to catch beam shafts

strobe_on_beat.hint: Pulse diode intensity with the audio beat

listing.blurb: Sharply focused concert lasers slice through undulating stage smoke overhead, forming liquid sky planes, expanding cones, and sweeping fans.
listing.prompt: A concert laser show through haze: sharp beams fan, scan and tunnel over the crowd from a rig above, sweeping in time with the beat, making cones, sheets and liquid-sky planes, each beam visible along its length in the smoke. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
